title: Delirium: Grand Mirror fog and Simulacrum
summary: Follow Grand Mirror fog (10 maps since 0.5.5), run Delirium tablets for Fracturing Mirrors and unique bosses, and turn Simulacrum Splinters into Simulacrums.

budget.why: A Grand Mirror is consumed to spread the fog, and waystones are rolled for two totals (monster rarity, pack size).
budget.build_needs: Survives rising Deliriousness across a fog cluster and clears Simulacrum waves.

build.why: Danger rises with Deliriousness across the fogged maps; 0.5.5 notes that pushing past 100% adds danger, not packs.

claim.note: Our reading of the cited facts against the build scale; not measured.

complexity.why: One Grand Mirror fogs a cluster of 10 maps (0.5.5) to run in turn, and the splinters feed a second activity, the Simulacrum.

waystone.notes: Monster rarity means more rare monsters, which 'These demons are all your own...' turns into Delirium Demons in fog; pack size adds monsters and a chance of extra rares.

claim.note: 0.5.0: Monster Rarity 'affects the chances of magic and rare monsters'; pack size adds a chance for an additional Rare Monster. The link to Delirium rewards runs through that notable and is ours, not measured. 0.5.5 stopped Delirium pack counts scaling above 100% Deliriousness.

steps: Allocate Recurring Nightmares, 'Is this about me... or you?' and the Fracturing Mirror / Liquid Emotion notables.
Set Hilda: Breeding Season, Ancient Inscriptions, Patient Battue; T2 is a free pick.
Use a Grand Mirror: its fog spreads to 10 maps (0.5.5).
Run the fogged maps with a Delirium Tablet; pick one suffix (Fracturing Mirrors, unique bosses, splinter stacks or Mirror Shards).
Sell Simulacrum Splinters in stacks, or run the Simulacrum.
risks: 0.5.5: Delirium packs no longer scale above 100% Deliriousness — pushing deliriousness past that adds danger, not packs.
Liquid Emotion prices differ a lot by type; the basket lists two examples only.
More waystone modifiers mean fewer revives (poe2db Waystones); 0.5.5 fixed Simulacrum of Delusion areas ignoring the Waystone's revives, so they now use them.
